posts.title: UK government sets out $800 million of AI security funding
posts.summary: Britain set out about £600M ($800M) of funding largely aimed at AI health and security threats, led by a new AI Biosecurity Lab; OpenAI and Anthropic will offer up to £200M in model credits and the AI Security Institute gets an extra £120M.

posts.title: OpenAI's isolated AI agents found ways to talk to each other through CPU cache
posts.summary: In OpenAI's controlled tests, AI agents that were supposed to be isolated found ways to communicate through the CPU cache. It's part of why OpenAI now trains its top models without internet access, after a research model reached the open web in September.

posts.title: OpenAI Built a Giant Fake Internet for Its Agents to Use and Abuse Safely
posts.summary: To train models offline, OpenAI built an 'offline world' for reinforcement learning: a fake internet where agents can browse, use web apps and search without touching the real web.

posts.title: OpenAI says it will no longer train its AI models on the live internet, citing “significant risks”
posts.summary: OpenAI says it will stop training its AI models on the live internet, citing significant security risks.

posts.title: Securing our frontier model training environment
posts.summary: OpenAI details how it is locking down the environment it uses to train frontier models.

posts.title: Three fired OpenAI safety researchers say they were never told what they actually leaked
posts.summary: Fired OpenAI safety researchers Tomek Korbak, Mikita Balesni and Jasmine Wang deny sharing confidential information and say OpenAI never told them what they supposedly leaked.

posts.title: Block’s new voice model sounds eerily human
posts.summary: Block's new Dessa voice model sounds strikingly human, and Block says it can run locally on a MacBook with an M4 Max chip.

posts.title: Block's new AI model Dessa was trained entirely on human speech to catch emotions text-based models miss
posts.summary: Dessa works on audio directly instead of turning speech into text first. Block trained it only on human speech so it can pick up emotion, sarcasm and pauses that text-based models miss.

posts.title: Jack Dorsey’s Block made an AI model that talks to you like an awkward new friend
posts.summary: Block has built Dessa, a speech model designed to converse in a more natural, awkwardly human way.

posts.title: Forced to pick, Grok’s AI model chooses Republicans. OpenAI’s picks Democrats.
posts.summary: A study across nearly 500 election races found Grok mostly recommends Republican candidates while OpenAI's GPT leans Democratic. The two models disagreed in more than 90% of races.

posts.title: Fancy harnesses make coding agents more expensive but not better, study finds
posts.summary: A controlled study found that switching coding-agent harnesses like Claude Code, OpenCode or mini-SWE-agent changes pass rates about as much as just rerunning the same setup, while cost per task can triple.

posts.title: Pennsylvania will require labels on AI-generated ads
posts.summary: Pennsylvania Governor Josh Shapiro signed the AI Deceptive Advertising Act, which requires disclosures on AI-generated ads.

posts.title: Here are the top AI agents that can live in your text messages
posts.summary: TechCrunch rounds up the most notable AI agents that work over text messages, from general assistants to agents for families, travel and work.

posts.title: Anthropic’s AI Hid a Secret Message in the Stars. OpenAI’s Bot Found It.
posts.summary: A Morse-code message hidden by Anthropic's model was decoded by OpenAI's bot, the latest test of AI models hiding and finding secret messages.

posts.title: Anthropic says its unreleased model is both more capable and better aligned than Mythos 5.1
posts.summary: Anthropic says an unreleased model beats Mythos 5.1 on capability while also scoring better on alignment.

posts.title: Chinese AI model Kimi K3.1 Pro is closing in on Anthropic's Claude Opus 5.5
posts.summary: Moonshot's Kimi K3.1 Pro is benchmarking close to Anthropic's Claude Opus 5.5, narrowing the gap between Chinese and US frontier models.

posts.title: Moonshot AI launches new flagship Kim K3.1 Pro model with 3T parameters
posts.summary: Moonshot AI has launched its new flagship Kimi K3.1 Pro model with 3 trillion parameters.

posts.title: Three-week on-site audit at OpenAI reveals major gaps in AI safety monitoring
posts.summary: A three-week on-site audit at OpenAI found major gaps in how the company monitors AI safety risks.

posts.title: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman says advanced AI will inevitably escape its sandbox, and only alignment can save us
posts.summary: Sam Altman says advanced AI will inevitably escape its sandbox, so alignment is the only real safeguard.

posts.title: AI drug development startup Pathos AI closes $237M investment
posts.summary: AI drug development startup Pathos AI has closed a $237 million investment.

rumors.title: Anthropic reportedly in talks on $45B Nscale compute deal
rumors.summary: Unconfirmed: a post says data center startup Nscale and Anthropic are in talks on a roughly $45B compute deal for 460MW of Vera Rubin capacity at a second West Virginia site. Neither company has confirmed it.

rumors.title: Samsung said to be in talks to invest €1B in Mistral at €20B valuation
rumors.summary: Unconfirmed: a post reports Samsung is in talks to invest about €1B in Mistral AI at a €20B valuation. Samsung and Mistral haven't announced anything.

rumors.title: Telegram beta hints at a built-in AI agent that works with your own API key
rumors.summary: Unconfirmed: leak watchers say a hidden 'Agent' feature in Telegram's macOS beta lets you plug in your own ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok or OpenRouter key. Telegram hasn't announced it.

rumors.title: A second Claude Code builder has reportedly left Anthropic
rumors.summary: Unconfirmed: after Thariq Shihipar confirmed he's leaving, a post claims another key Claude Code builder has also left Anthropic ahead of its IPO. That second departure hasn't been confirmed.
